After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance, the nonzero mapSynth_LPBalance entries only belong to keys that are either the caller's own address or an address explicitly set by the contract's public functions.
After a call to allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance at any address that is not msg.sender and not address(0) must be zero.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance, the public getter mapSynth_LPBalance must return 0 for any address that was never set as a caller in any preceding transaction.
After any call to allowance(address,address), the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all addresses that are not msg.sender and not address(this) must be zero.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance(address(this)) must equal the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all addresses except address(0).
After a call to allowance, the caller's mapSynth_LPBalance is unchanged when the caller is the contract itself and the spender is arbitrary.

After calling allowance, the sum of mapSynth_LPDebt across all addresses is unchanged relative to its value before the call.

After any allowance call, the ratio of mapSynth_LPBalance to mapSynth_LPDebt for any pool address that existed before the call remains within a bounded range (specifically, the new ratio is not less than half the old ratio).

After a call to allowance(address,address), the value of mapSynth_LPDebt at any address for which it was nonzero before the call has not decreased by more than the amount of synthetic tokens burned from that address in the same call.
After any call to allowance(address,address), the total supply of C remains unchanged.
After a call to allowance(address,address), the value of mapSynth_LPDebt at any address that existed before the call equals the value after the call, because allowance never changes mapSynth_LPDebt.
